reviews.title: Paywalled. Use this alternative.
reviews.text: This app has great features but charges an arm and a leg for simple shortcut actions. If you just want to be able to hide apps like I do in my case. Use ScreenZen, go to more -> extra features -> on demand blocking -> settings. you can select AS MANY APPS AS YOU WANT and then if you make a new custom shortcut in the shortcuts app you can do (on demand blocking) and set it to something like double tap on the back of your phone. I did a lot of research to find the best app.
